$comment: Declarative-only. Agents READ this; nobody writes status here. State is derived from the filesystem (see scripts/lib/state.mjs and AGENTS.md). Run `pnpm queue` to see the current derived state of every feature.
description: Spec-driven feature backlog. Human-owned. The leader picks the lowest-id pending feature and dispatches.

features.name: blog-only-template
features.title: Add a blog-only template variant
features.description: Strip projects + marketing pages from starter; keep blog + i18n + tokens + consent + Lighthouse budget. Goal: a contributor or end user can scaffold a Markdown-first blog without ripping marketing content out of starter by hand.
acceptance: packages/templates/blog-only/ exists and ships every locked practice (see Principles in AGENTS.md)
scaffold.ts strips email/Resend deps when the template has no src/lib/email/index.ts
pnpm scaffold:test with the blog-only fixture passes Lighthouse budget

features.name: registry-block-pricing-card
features.title: First block-tier registry item: PricingCard
features.description: Compose Card + Button + (new) PriceTag atom into a PricingCard block. First exercise of the blocks tier, which currently has no items.
acceptance: packages/registry/blocks/pricing-card/ exists with PricingCard.astro + a demo .mdx
registry.json lists it with correct registryDependencies (cn, card, button, priceTag-if-needed)
No React, no Radix, no framework JS — Astro + vanilla only

features.name: doctor-shipped-in-templates
features.title: Ship pnpm doctor inside the templates
features.description: Phase 2 of the harness — when the CLI user opts into harness scaffolding, scripts/doctor/ + scripts/committer + .claude/agents/ + openspec/ land in their repo.
acceptance: create-astro-ignite prompts ask 'Include AI harness scaffolding?' (default: false)
When yes: the scaffolded repo has scripts/doctor/, scripts/committer, scripts/audit/, openspec/, .claude/agents/, feature_list.json, progress/
When no: scaffold.ts strips all of the above and the relevant package.json scripts
